explanation:
Choice A is correct. It's given that the graph shows the estimated resale value $y$, in dollars, of a bicycle as a function of the number of weeks since it was purchased, $x$. The y-intercept of a graph is the point at which the graph intersects the y-axis, or when $x$ is $0$. The graph shown intersects the y-axis at the point $\left(0, 180\right)$. It follows that $0$ weeks after the bicycle was purchased, or when the bicycle was purchased, the estimated resale value of the bicycle was $180$ dollars. Therefore, the best interpretation of the y-intercept is that the estimated resale value of the bicycle was $$180$ when it was purchased.

Why C is incorrect:

Choice C is incorrect. The estimated resale value of the bicycle had decreased by approximately $180 - \30, or \$$150, not $$180$, in the $36$ weeks after it was purchased.
